name: snapshot_time
description: UTC timestamp of the OpenSky server state snapshot

name: icao24
description: Unique ICAO 24-bit transponder address in hex string representation

name: callsign
description: Flight callsign (e.g. BAW123, DLH572) trimmed of trailing whitespace

name: origin_country
description: Country where the aircraft is registered

name: time_position
description: UTC timestamp of the last position update received

name: last_contact
description: UTC timestamp of the last message received from this aircraft

name: on_ground
description: True if the aircraft is reporting position on ground

name: velocity_mps
description: Velocity over ground in meters per second

name: true_track
description: True track in decimal degrees clockwise from north

name: vertical_rate_mps
description: Vertical rate in meters per second (positive = climbing, negative = descending)

name: spi
description: Special Purpose Indicator (ident triggered by pilot)
